dedupe_keys.name: afad earthquake catalogue and event service for turkiye

description: AFAD, Türkiye's disaster and emergency management authority, publishes the national earthquake catalogue from its seismic network: a live list of the latest 100 earthquakes and a filterable event service that returns, for each event, time, latitude, longitude, depth, magnitude type and value, and the province, district and neighbourhood, with records back to at least 1990. AFAD also publishes yearly one-page statistics of nature-caused events compiled from its disaster management decision support system (AYDES); the 2024 summary counts 7,767 events, including 5,321 forest fires, 1,818 floods, 332 landslides and 194 earthquakes of magnitude 4 or more. The data are available free on the AFAD websites; no licence is named on the pages read. Caveats: the event service is undocumented and magnitude types vary over time, and the yearly statistics are counts only. It supports hazard catalogues for seismic scenario and exposure analysis of Turkish infrastructure; a related record is the USGS ComCat earthquake catalogue.
